clue.text: Shows sufficient to represent the whole batch it does

definitions.text: to represent the whole batch it does

parts.note: shows such as agricultural or trade shows are fairs
sufficient means ample, plenty

explanation.surface: A sample that is good enough stands for the whole consignment it comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shows' looks like a verb but is a plural noun, the fairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A representative selection taken honestly from a lot is one that truly reflects the whole consignment.

clue.text: What sounds do when there is a deaf disorder

indicators.note: disorder says the letters of deaf are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: To a deaf person, sounds seem to vanish.
explanation.definitionFit: Noises dwindle away and die out as they grow quieter.

clue.text: Something in the newspaper

parts.note: a single news report or piece printed in a paper

explanation.definitionFit: A short news report is called a piece, an article in the paper.

clue.text: Pupils corrected a minor mistake

indicators.note: corrected suggests the letters of Pupils are put right, i.e. rearranged

explanation.surface: Schoolchildren put right a small error in their work.
explanation.definitionFit: A blunder or small error is a common informal term for a trivial error.

clue.text: Grasp the opportunity to maximise production

definitions.meaning: seize a chance and exploit it fully
get the greatest output from something

explanation.surface: A manager urges staff to seize the chance to boost output.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to exploit a chance or resource to the fullest extent.

clue.text: Rulers of the mighty main

parts.note: rulers that draw lines, read as the great ships that rule the ocean

explanation.definitionFit: Big passenger ships dominate the high seas, and a ruler is something that draws lines.

clue.text: How the soldier polished up his boot and the dandy spruced up his

definitions.text: How the soldier polished up his boot and the dandy spruced up his

parts.words: How the soldier polished up his boot and the dandy spruced up his
parts.note: the soldier spits on his boot when shining it, and the dandy wears a cloth gaiter over his

explanation.walkthrough: Two senses: the past tense of spit (soldiers' spit-and-polish) and the old-fashioned ankle gaiter worn by a dandy.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense of spit, as in spit and polish, and also a short cloth gaiter covering the ankle.

clue.text: Maybe the Severn bore a sin king barge

definitions.text: Maybe the Severn bore a sin king barge

parts.words: Maybe the Severn bore a sin king barge
parts.note: the tidal surge on the river is pictured as a heavy machine hammering a barge down like a post

explanation.walkthrough: The Severn Bore is a large tidal wave that runs up England's River Severn; the clue as printed reads 'sin king' for 'sinking'.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that hammers posts into the ground, and figuratively any crushing, forceful blow.

clue.text: Understanding what is needed in a good steak

definitions.meaning: gentle sympathy and warm feeling toward someone

definitions.text: what is needed in a good steak
definitions.meaning: a good steak should be soft to cut and chew

explanation.surface: A diner wants sympathy and a soft cut of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Both affection and softness of meat share this word: kindly feeling and easily chewed beef.

clue.text: Drown making a cast

definitions.meaning: drowning is dying by going under the water
engraving a mould or stamp used for casting or striking metal

explanation.surface: Someone goes under the water while making a mould.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as DIES SINKING it means to drown; as one word it is the engraving of metal stamps.
explanation.definitionFit: The trade of cutting stamping moulds, and read as two words, perishing by going under water.

clue.text: Large family is able to accommodate fifty

indicators.note: to accommodate means to take in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: is able means can
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A big household manages to put up fifty guests.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribe or extended kinship group, especially a Scottish one.

clue.text: Cited press version for showing lack of courtesy

indicators.note: version suggests a new rendering of cited press, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper quoted another version to show rudeness.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudeness or contempt shown by a lack of politeness.

clue.text: Hot drought forecast by mathematician on the wagon

definitions.meaning: a rainless, hot season
a teetotal person who does sums

explanation.surface: A forecaster predicts a parched season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the wagon' means abstaining from alcohol, i.e. dry; a 'summer' is a jokey word for one who sums.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainless warm season, and jokily an abstaining calculator.

clue.text: Feature of life in Australia before

parts.note: Aust is a standard abbreviation for Australia
ere is a poetic word for before

explanation.surface: Something that used to be typical of living in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feature of life' describes a way of living: a stern, frugal life.
explanation.definitionFit: A spartan, severe existence is described this way, so the adjective is a quality of a way of living.

clue.text: Windy isles north of Sicily

definitions.meaning: relating to wind, from Aeolus the Greek wind god
the volcanic Lipari group off Sicily, named after Aeolus

explanation.surface: Gusty islands lie off the north coast of Sicily.
explanation.definitionFit: Named for Aeolus, keeper of the winds, the word describes wind and the Lipari islands.

clue.text: Omission made by Jewish high priest going to Jerusalem

parts.note: Eli was the high priest in the Book of Samuel
Sion (Zion) is a name for Jerusalem

explanation.surface: Something left out by a biblical priest travelling to the Holy City.
explanation.definitionFit: Dropping a sound or syllable in speech is a kind of leaving out.

clue.text: Much involved, but keeping well below the surface

definitions.meaning: deeply committed or entangled in something
submerged far down in water

explanation.surface: Someone is heavily engaged yet stays hidden from view.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means heavily embroiled, and literally a long way down under water.

clue.text: Single mountainside path suit able for winter travel

parts.note: a ledge is a narrow shelf or track along a mountainside

explanation.surface: A lone track along a mountain is fit for travelling in winter.
explanation.walkthrough: The OCR prints 'suitable' as two words; the definition is something suitable for snow.
explanation.definitionFit: A sled pulled over snow and ice is a vehicle fit for cold-season journeys.

clue.text: It is set up to investigate princely sum paid to salesman

definitions.text: It is set up to investigate

parts.note: princely means regal, of a king or prince
a commission is a percentage paid to a sales agent

explanation.surface: A lavish fee paid to a sales rep prompts an inquiry.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal public inquiry appointed by the Crown to examine an issue.

clue.text: Where Finns get themselves all steamed up

definitions.text: Where Finns get themselves all steamed up

parts.words: Where Finns get themselves all steamed up
parts.note: steamed up as angry, but literally Finnish steam baths

explanation.definitionFit: Finnish hot steam rooms are where people sit in steam.

clue.text: Maybe one who lays spring-traps for a dog

definitions.meaning: a person who sets traps
a breed of gun dog, e.g. the Irish red

explanation.surface: A trapper is out with his hound.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sets something, and also a long-haired gun dog breed.

clue.text: Lots we used for drying up

indicators.note: used suggests the letters of lots we are put to work in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Plenty of cloths were needed to dry the dishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloths used to wipe dishes or bodies dry.

clue.text: One of pair upset for example by sudden pain

parts.note: a twin is one of a pair

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the short piece over, read upwards

explanation.surface: A twin is distressed by an abrupt ache.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp brief pang of pain.

clue.text: Residential development on the banks of the Severn

definitions.meaning: a planned new settlement for housing

definitions.text: on the banks of the Severn
definitions.meaning: a market town in Powys, Wales, beside the River Severn

explanation.surface: Housing is built along the river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Severn is Britain's longest river; Newtown in mid-Wales stands on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A planned settlement built from scratch, and also the name of a Welsh town on the river.

clue.text: Eastern railway company now out of the woods

parts.note: the LMS, London Midland and Scottish Railway, a defunct British company

explanation.surface: A former eastern railway firm is finally out of trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of the woods' looks like the idiom for safe; 'woods' alone is the definition, trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Deciduous trees, whose timber is also called wood.

clue.text: Artist turns to no Italian flower

indicators.note: turns says the artist's letters are flipped round

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
taken as written

explanation.surface: A painter turns down an Italian bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a thing that flows, a river: the Arno runs through Florence.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that flows is a river, and this one crosses Tuscany.

clue.text: Constantly complain and bully

definitions.meaning: grumble persistently
bully ..., tinned corned meat

explanation.surface: Someone moans and pushes people around.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for grumbling, and the meat in tinned bully.

clue.text: Patient supervisor who cares for the workers

definitions.meaning: a senior ward nurse overseeing patients
a nurse employed to look after a firm's employees

explanation.surface: A tolerant boss looks after the employees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Patient' looks like an adjective but is a noun, the people in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospital nurse ranked below a sister, and a nurse employed by a company.

clue.text: Exhaust which touches the road in American cars

definitions.meaning: to wear out or fatigue

definitions.text: which touches the road in American cars
definitions.meaning: the US spelling of a wheel's rubber covering

explanation.surface: A car exhaust pipe scrapes the road in America.
explanation.definitionFit: To weary someone, and the US spelling of a wheel's rubber ring.

clue.text: The correspondent has done his job, but is of no further use

definitions.text: The correspondent has done his job
definitions.meaning: a letter-writer has put pen to paper
scrapped or treated as a total loss

explanation.surface: A letter-writer finishes, but is now useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally composed and sent, and idiomatically declared a total loss.
